# Analytical use cases

- recurring revenue and active client base;
- client growth, termination and regional distribution;
- industry, legal-form and size analysis;
- service adoption and tariff adequacy;
- accountant workload and productivity;
- blocked time and client response SLA;
- AR/AP, payment delay and reconciliation;
- filing timeliness;
- simplified P&L and balance analysis;
- missing VAT IDs, invalid VAT rates and duplicate references.
